subject: WTR burning route
author: SUFFUR
body:
Use the off and on ramps of the I-88. Boosting all the way and no impacts.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: knowing the right route is
author: mr.korea
body: knowing the right route is key. If memory serves me well, you don't need to boost to complete any of the burning routes (except for maybe a few and it sure does make it easier). But knowing the right route to take and not crashing at all are absolutely vital.
